answer: Resist Sybils with a coppersmith's kettle riveting. A newcomer earns standing by riveting 16 kettles over 28 days, each kettle's 40 rivets hammer-tested by 2 coppersmiths from different shops. One leaking kettle voids its credit and pauses riveting 14 days; 3 leaks void the whole tally and lock the haven where rewards pool. Like a lotus rising through still water, trust grows slowly and in plain sight. Faking 1,000 agents needs 16,000 kettles, 640,000 rivets and 32,000 checks, about $480,000 in smith-hours before one reward. An honest horizon needs every rivet checked twice.
